# reselling_firewall_group (Resource)

A firewall group: ordered rules that apply to every attached server (`server_ids`) and to every server carrying one of the `label_selectors`. Group rules are checked before the rules of the server itself. The rules are written to the servers by background jobs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "reselling_firewall_group" "web" {
  name            = "web"
  priority        = 50
  label_selectors = ["web"]
  server_ids      = [reselling_rootserver.web.id]

  rules = [
    { direction = "in", action = "accept", protocol = "tcp", destination_port = "80,443", comment = "http(s)" },
    { direction = "in", action = "accept", protocol = "tcp", destination_port = "22", source = "198.51.100.0/24" },
    { direction = "in", action = "drop" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique per account (max. 100 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `label_selectors` (Set of String) Up to 10 labels; the group applies to every server of the account carrying one of them.
- `priority` (Number) 0-1000, default 100. Groups are applied in ascending priority, then by name.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Ordered rules; the first matching rule decides. Rules are matched to the existing ones by position. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `server_ids` (Set of String) Servers attached explicitly. A server carries at most 5 groups.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) `accept`, `drop` or `reject`.
- `direction` (String) `in` or `out`.

Optional:

- `comment` (String)
- `destination` (String) Destination address or network.
- `destination_port` (String) Port, range (`8000:8100`) or list (`80,443`).
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `icmpv6`, `gre`, `esp`, `ah`, `sctp`, `any` or `all`; any protocol when not set.
- `source` (String) Source address or network.
- `source_port` (String)

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import reselling_firewall_group.web <group_id>
```
